shared_elements: a figure-like form with outstretched/radiating limbs or appendages
justification: A shows a detailed, richly ornamented winged anthropomorphic figure in profile holding a bucket and raising a cone beside a flowering plant, with careful rendering of feathers, garment fringes, hair and hands; B shows only a faint, crudely incised radiating form with a few splayed limb-like lines and no attributes, dress or accompanying motifs. The only correspondence is the very generic presence of an incised figure-like shape with extended appendages, which any tradition could produce independently.
